title: NC-Scorer: Automated Variant Prioritization in Suspected Genetic Kidney Disease
description:
NC-Scorer (Nephro Candidate Scorer) is an open-source web application and computational framework for standardized, automated prioritization of candidate genetic variants and novel disease gene discovery in patients with suspected inherited kidney disease (IKD) and chronic kidney disease of unknown etiology (CKDu).

The Nephro Candidate Score (NCS) framework integrates three complementary sub-scores scaled to [0, 10]: (1) Nephro Gene Score (N-GS) predicting kidney disease relevance using an XGBoost machine learning model trained on functional genomics features, (2) Nephro Variant Score (N-VS) assessing variant pathogenicity via regularized logistic regression, and (3) a heuristic Inheritance Score (IS) evaluating disease model compatibility. Results can be explored interactively, computed in batch (up to 200 variants), and exported in JSON, CSV, TSV, or VCF format.
